text: “I wish I had any name but Elliot. I am sick of it. The name of Walter I can drop, thank God! and I desire you will never insult me with my second W. again, meaning, for the rest of my life, to be only yours truly, “WM. ELLIOT.” Such a letter could not be read without putting Anne in a glow; and Mrs Smith, observing the high colour in her face, said— “The language, I know, is highly disrespectful.
